## Fixer Receipt

**Status:** completed  
**Phase:** apply  
**Commit:** `f0bed0ea39100b1101ce1287ce4db505c884a671`  
**Title:** `fix(recorder): consume quoted assignment values`  
**Parent/start HEAD:** `b9bdd02ef4bb9fefd969d8af3e81e24bd55b998e` (strict forward descendant; clean tree)

### Root cause
`token-assignment` used `['"]?[^'"\s]+`, so a quoted multiword value matched only through the first token (`password="correct`) and left whitespace-delimited suffixes (` horse battery staple"`). The same prefix-only failure appeared on JSON-escaped forms (`password=\"...\"`) when receipt JSON rode `execution.argv` / `child.stdout` into the promoted manifest.

### Fix (owned seam only)
Extended the sole `token-assignment` rule in `src/recorder/scanner.ts` (regenerated `dist/recorder/scanner.js`) with value alternatives:
- `'[^'\r\n]+'`
- `"[^"\r\n]+"`
- `\\"[^"\r\n]+\\"` (JSON-escaped double quotes on argv/stdout surfaces)
- unquoted `[^\s'"\r\n]+` (prior non-whitespace boundary)

No new scanner, post-pass, or promotion-specific sanitizer.

### Tests
- Focused unit cases: double- and single-quoted multiword assignments redacted by `token-assignment`; full value and suffixes absent; surrounding text kept; unquoted boundary preserved.
- `category × credential` matrix extended with `password="correct horse battery staple"` on the receipt path; asserts no full value or whitespace-delimited suffix in promoted docket/receipt/manifest/redaction-report.

### Verification
- `npm run build:recorder` — pass
- focused `node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='quoted|assignment|category × credential' test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts` — pass
- `npm run typecheck` — pass

Authorized files only: `src/recorder/scanner.ts`, `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`, `dist/recorder/scanner.js`. No Soul/schema/runtime/CLI contract changes; no assertion weakening; prior standards repair preserved; exactly one new forward commit.
